patterns.note: A flexible grid layout presents portfolio items as distinct visual blocks, adapting column count based on viewport width to prioritize project imagery.
Clean, neutral sans-serif typography is used consistently, with uppercase for navigation and branding elements, and varied weights to establish a clear content hierarchy.
The site's core palette is minimalist, relying on a stark white background and dark text, allowing the vibrant and diverse colors within the portfolio project images to provide visual interest.
Both the primary site header and the category filter navigation remain sticky at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, keeping key navigation elements persistently accessible.
Each portfolio item functions as a self-contained visual card, featuring a prominent image or color block with a project title and category label directly below it.

technique_notes: The main content area utilizes a responsive grid system that dynamically adjusts the number of columns to optimize the display of portfolio items across different screen sizes.

The top-level header and the secondary filter navigation are implemented as sticky elements, fixing them to the top of the browser window so that content scrolls underneath, maintaining constant access to site navigation and content filtering.
No complex scroll-triggered animations or reveals are used; the design relies on static hierarchy and sticky elements for user experience.

design_tokens.type_scale: Clean sans-serif with a clear hierarchy: large, bold titles for portfolio items (~2x body), smaller uppercase for navigation and branding (~0.8x body), and standard body text for descriptions.

standout: The design is distinctive for its stark, almost gallery-like presentation, where the portfolio items themselves are the primary visual focus. The minimalist chrome, combined with a sticky filter bar, prioritizes content discovery and browsing without visual distraction.
